background: Clydesdale Bank PLC is the operating bank of Virgin Money, now a subsidiary of Nationwide Building Society, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending on mortgages, cards and to smaller companies.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the bank, A+ on a stable outlook; the last move was a withdrawal by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026. Capital is on the weak side of UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 13.8% and leverage of 6.1% both below the peer median, though leverage has risen 0.7 points since 31 Dec 2024. Liquidity is mixed: NSFR of 143% is in the top quarter but LCR of 159% is below the peer median. The figures are to 31 Dec 2025, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
